thread:
Jenna (Product): Quick sync on the Usage & Billing dashboard designs. Main goals: make spend trends, per-model token breakdowns, and invoices easy for org admins and finance. Dropping two sketches here. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc

Omar (Design): Sketches A/B in Figma. A = split-screen: left time series & filters, right detailed tables (models, projects, invoices). B = hierarchical nav: Overview -> Projects -> Billing, with sticky org selector. B would make invoices discoverable.

Priya (Eng): Heads up: per-model token breakout at 1d granularity for hundreds of projects is heavy. We can support aggregated views (top N models, monthly buckets) and provide on-demand detailed exports. Real-time for last 14 days is doable if we limit to 30 projects selected.

Ben (Finance): Export requirements: CSV with invoice_line_id, project_id, model, tokens_prompt, tokens_completion, tokens_total, unit_price, line_cost, tax, proration_start, proration_end. Also need PDF invoices with company billing address and VAT number. Avoid burying downloads behind modal flows.

Omar (Design): Noted. For accessibility: use patterned fills for stacked area charts, and ensure chart legends have text labels that are keyboard focusable. Color palette must be friendly for deuteranopia.

Kavi (Security): Reminder: invoices and exports are PII-sensitive for some customers. Enforce org-level RBAC: only Billing Admin and Finance role can download CSV/PDF. Add audit event logs for all downloads.

Liz (Support): From support tickets: customers often ask "why did my project spike?" — they want per-route attribution (API key / route) alongside model-level breakdown. Can we surface a lightweight route-level table in Projects tab?

Jenna (Product): Proposed decisions: 
1) Use Hierarchical nav (Overview/Projects/Billing) with a persistent org selector. 
2) Overview shows 30d spend (absolute) + % change vs prior period, with quick toggles for 7/30/90. 
3) Token breakdown shows top 5 models by cost and an expandable matrix for projects x models. 
4) Billing tab = invoice list + quick download action; CSV exports via dedicated endpoint.

Priya (Eng): Backend plan:
- Add endpoints: `/api/billing/summary?org_id=&range=30d` and `/api/billing/models?org_id=&range=7d&limit=5`.
- Add `/api/billing/invoices?org_id=&format=csv&start=&end=` for exports with RBAC check.
- We should include `data_freshness` field in responses when using nightly rollups.

billing-bot: Alert: high aggregation queries spiked on 2025-01-09T02:12Z for `/api/billing/models` -> 99th pctl 3.2s. Consider adding rate limits and cache headers.

Priya (Eng): For UI perf: lazy-load the per-project matrix and provide a CSV download button that triggers a server-side job for full-detail exports. Show progress + notification when ready.

Omar (Design): UX notes: 
- Use clear copy: "Viewing: Organization — Acme Corp" and "Scope: All projects / Selected project". 
- Dont use "tokens" alone; label as "Billed tokens (prompt + completion)". 
- Add microcopy under charts explaining cost calc and link to docs.

Ben (Finance): Also need monthly billing cycles and proration cell in CSV for customers who changed committed capacity mid-month. And an easy way to request historical invoice reissue (support flow).

Kavi (Security): For exports, require short-lived signed URLs for CSV/PDF downloads, rotate keys, and log S3 access events. Also warn on UI if invoice contains emails/PII and mask where possible.

Liz (Support): Onboarding tip: include a "How to read this bill" help card in Billing tab with example rows. That reduces basic support churn.

Jenna (Product): A11y + mobile: make sure charts collapse into list items on mobile with numeric summaries. Keyboard nav for table rows + export button accessible via keyboard.

Omar (Design): Will iterate mocks: replace color-only legends with pattern + text, add data-staleness badge, include export CTA in Billing header, design mobile stack. Will post frames in 24h.

Priya (Eng): Timelines: rough estimate: Overview + top-5 models + staleness indicator = 1 sprint. Projects matrix + lazy CSV job = 1 sprint. Invoices tab + signed download URLs + RBAC = 1 sprint. Depends on auth infra availability.

Ben (Finance): I'll provide sample CSV fixtures and legal wording for invoices by EOD. Also, please add unit tests for CSV schema.

Jenna (Product): Decision log: tabs (Overview/Projects/Billing), export endpoint + signed URL, RBAC for downloads, patterns for charts, staleness badge, route-level table as progressive enhancement. I'll create tickets and link the Figma.

billing-bot: New task created: billing-exports-job queued by Priya at 2025-01-10T09:00Z.

Priya (Eng): I'll follow up with API contract tomorrow. If anyone has strong objections to the signed-URL approach speak now.

Kavi (Security): Signed URLs are fine with short TTL and audit logging. Approve.

Jenna (Product): Thanks team 10x. We'll reconvene after the first mock update. If any urgent blockers post here.
